title: Parametric and Implicit Functions
notes: **Parametric and Implicit Functions:** This topic covers the fundamental concepts of parametric and implicit functions in the mathematics curriculum.
Understanding parametric and implicit functions is essential for solving problems and building higher-level mathematical skills.
Key definitions and theorems related to parametric and implicit functions should be memorized and practiced regularly.

Practice with multiple examples to solidify your understanding.

Try to derive the key formulas from first principles.
Create a summary sheet with all important formulas and theorems.
